Create an edgeR object

Source: R/create_object.R
create_edger_obj.Rd

Converts a ScreenR object into an edgeR DGEList, for example to use the object with edgeR or limma functions directly. The edgeR/limma based functions of ScreenR (such as find_camera_hit and find_roast_hit) call it internally. The DGEList is built from the raw counts (the count table), as required by the edgeR negative binomial model, and the annotation is matched to the counts by barcode; all the barcodes of the count table must be in the annotation table.

Usage

create_edger_obj(screenR_Object)

Arguments

screenR_Object

The ScreenR object obtained using create_screenr_object.

Value

A DGEList with the raw counts, the groups of the samples and the annotation of the barcodes (genes).

See also

create_design_matrix

Examples

object <- get0("object", envir = asNamespace("ScreenR"))
create_edger_obj(object)
